title: Quantification of Nitrogen and Phosphorus in grass and soil samples using ICP-OES
author: Gabriel Mayengo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bb7tirnn

steps.title: Determine Total Nitrogen in Samples
steps.instruction: Perform total nitrogen determination via dry combustion (elementary analysis) using an elemental analyser (Vario EL, Elementar, Germany) according to ISO 13878.

steps.title: Digest Plant Samples
steps.instruction: Perform pressure digestion of plant samples using a microwave-heated high pressure digestion system (Ultra Clave II, MLS GmbH, Germany).

substeps.instruction: Place 200 mg of sample and 5 ml of nitric acid into quartz vessels.
Digest at 220°C and 100 bar for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Digest Soil Samples for Total Phosphorus
steps.instruction: Extract total phosphorus from soil samples using aqua regia digestion.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 3 g of sample into a quartz digestion tube.
Add a mixture (aqua regia) of 37% HCl and 65% HNO3.
Allow the mixture to stand overnight at room temperature.
Boil the sample for two hours under reflux conditions.
Cool the sample and transfer it to a 100-ml volumetric flask.
Fill to volume with water and filter into a storage vessel.

steps.title: Measure Total Phosphorus Content
steps.instruction: Measure the total P content in both soil and plant samples using inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectrometry (ICP-OES).

substeps.instruction: Perform external calibration against certified standards from various suppliers.
